purpose: Catalog high-value online open-content, open-data, mixed-license and reference-first sources for later ARI-governed acquisition and PCA/SMB/SAA/P3D production use.

rights_tiers.C: mixed_or_per_item_rights; verify each asset/dataset and upstream record before use

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.license_posture: All downloadable assets CC0 1.0
sources.notes: Use public API/documented bulk route; site ToS forbids scraping/data mining without permission.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.license_posture: All downloadable assets CC0 1.0

sources.name: Kenney Assets
sources.license_posture: Asset-page game assets are CC0/public domain
sources.notes: Do not treat Kenney logos/branding as CC0 assets.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.license_posture: Natural Earth raster and vector map data public domain

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.license_posture: Items marked Open Access are CC0
sources.notes: Use only CC0-designated media; non-copyright rights can still apply.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.license_posture: Public-domain artwork images and open-access data released under CC0

sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
sources.license_posture: Open-access images/data marked CC0

sources.name: National Gallery of Art Open Access
sources.license_posture: Open-access public-domain artwork images released CC0; factual dataset CC0

sources.name: NYPL Public Domain Collections
sources.license_posture: Items in the designated public-domain collection are unrestricted for reuse

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.license_posture: Main/property/lexeme structured data CC0

sources.name: LibriVox
sources.license_posture: LibriVox recordings are public domain in the United States
sources.notes: Check copyright/public-domain status in relevant non-US jurisdictions when applicable.

sources.name: Game-icons.net
sources.license_posture: CC BY 3.0

sources.name: Google Fonts
sources.license_posture: Fonts released under open-source licenses; exact family license varies

sources.name: OpenMoji
sources.license_posture: CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.notes: Attribution and ShareAlike obligations apply to adapted material.

sources.name: Heroicons
sources.license_posture: Current open-source repository is MIT

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.license_posture: Open Database License (ODbL)
sources.notes: Attribution and database share-alike requirements apply; public tile/API services have separate usage policies.

sources.name: GeoNames
sources.license_posture: Gazetteer exports CC BY 4.0
sources.notes: Some specialized source fields/datasets can carry additional notices; retain source metadata.

sources.name: U.S. Geological Survey
sources.license_posture: USGS-produced data/information generally U.S. public domain; third-party material can be copyrighted
sources.notes: Check third-party credits and likeness/publicity issues.

sources.name: NASA Images/Data/3D Resources
sources.license_posture: NASA-produced content generally not subject to U.S. copyright, with third-party, logo, endorsement and likeness exceptions

sources.name: NOAA Media and Data
sources.license_posture: NOAA-created media generally public domain; third-party/restricted items exist

sources.name: Library of Congress Free to Use and Reuse
sources.license_posture: Curated rights-free sets may be public domain, no-known-copyright or cleared for public use; consult collection/item rights statement

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.license_posture: Reusable media under multiple free/public-domain licenses; requirements vary by file

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.license_posture: Mixed Creative Commons, Standard, Editorial and other item-level terms
sources.notes: Never infer rights from downloadability. Preserve model UID/license; editorial assets are not normal game-production inputs.

sources.name: BlendSwap
sources.license_posture: Uploader-declared CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA and other licenses plus General Asset License
sources.notes: BlendSwap states uploader licenses are not independently verified; API/MCP does not add rights.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.license_posture: Multiple open licenses including CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and GPL-family options

sources.name: Freesound
sources.license_posture: Per-sound CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC
sources.notes: Also preserve uploader AI-training preference metadata where relevant to model-training use.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.license_posture: Aggregates Creative Commons/public-domain metadata; license accuracy not guaranteed
sources.notes: Use original host as rights/provenance source when practical.

sources.name: Europeana
sources.license_posture: Per-object Creative Commons tools/licenses or standardized RightsStatements

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.license_posture: Mixed rights; item metadata/uploader claims vary and can include copyrighted works
sources.notes: Archive presence is never evidence of public-domain or open-license status.

sources.name: itch.io Game Assets
sources.license_posture: Mixed creator licenses; platform exposes CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/NC filters among others

sources.name: Musopen
sources.license_posture: Aims to host public-domain music/recordings but user-upload status must be independently assessed

sources.name: GBIF
sources.license_posture: Datasets use CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC; media can carry item/source terms

sources.name: OpenTopography
sources.license_posture: Hosted data broadly free of copyright restrictions; some datasets CC BY or other open terms; citation required
sources.notes: Website text/images are not the same as hosted data; API keys have use restrictions.

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub
sources.license_posture: Per-repository license/model-card/dataset-card; open and custom licenses coexist
sources.notes: Model license does not by itself prove training-data rights or output clearance.

sources.name: Digital Public Library of America
sources.license_posture: Aggregated institutional collections with item/source-specific rights statements

sources.name: Biodiversity Heritage Library
sources.license_posture: Public-domain and Creative Commons material mixed with collection-specific rights

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.license_posture: Quaternius Asset License v1.0; free commercial product use/modification but no standalone redistribution of original or modified assets
sources.notes: Official license updated 2026-08-28; do not rely on older marketplace CC0 tags.

sources.name: Civitai
sources.license_posture: User models may carry bespoke/base-model restrictions; service access/automation terms apply
sources.notes: Manual rights/provenance review required; no scraping or bulk trust. Treat training-data/output-rights uncertainty independently.

continuous_expansion: Add recurring upstream providers discovered through Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, Europeana, museum/public-sector APIs and other lawful discovery channels as first-class entries with verified terms before production use.
